conviction_note: Baseline median reaction is only 3.9% but the max is 56% and 20d realised vol is 146%, so the distribution is wide; I tilt it negative because the company announced a wholesale business-model pivot and rebrand 48 hours before the print and the tape rejected it violently (intraday +31% closing -24% on 300x normal volume), which is the signature of a company reframing ahead of bad numbers.

findings.finding: On 2026-09-01, two days before the results print, Amber International announced it was abandoning its 'Amber Premium' digital-asset wealth identity and rebranding to AMBR as an 'agentic AI company', launching AI agents Ambre and MIA - a total repositioning of the business released at 3:30 AM ET on PR Newswire, immediately ahead of the numbers.
findings.corpus_ref: docs/6b85260769557edb0697f5f8fb5e6b9aced19f03.txt (snapshots/20260901T150802Z.json item 1); the underlying company filing is filings.json accession 0001104659-26-103605, form 6-K accepted 2026-08-31T09:21:07Z
findings.why_not_priced: The headline is priced - it is what moved the stock. What is not priced is the read-through: a sub-$100m issuer that discards its entire brand and stated business model 48 hours before releasing results is almost always pre-framing a bad set of numbers, and there is no sell-side coverage, no news-search coverage (every snapshot has n_queries=0) and no analyst preview anywhere in this capture to make that connection. If the market had connected them, the pivot day would not have opened +14% pre-market on retail gapper lists.
findings.independence: The 6-K accepted 2026-08-31T09:21:07Z, three days before the print, is a second, company-sourced document pointing at unusual pre-print disclosure activity - https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1697818/000110465926103605/tm2624351d1_6k.htm

findings.finding: quote.json shows 15,889,900 shares traded on 2026-09-01 against a 20-day average near 1.09m and a late-August run of 19k-55k a day - roughly 29% of the ~55m float turning over in one session, with the close at 0.88 after an intraday high well above 1.40, i.e. a complete distribution of the pivot rally into the print.
findings.why_not_priced: A 300x volume day that closes at the low is a supply fact, not a news fact, and no aggregator publishes it. The stock also printed sub-$1.00 closes on 08-19, 08-20, 08-21 and 09-01, putting it inside the Nasdaq $1.00 minimum-bid window with a results print as the next catalyst - if the market were discounting a forced compliance action the stock would not have been bid +14% pre-market on a rebrand.
findings.independence: A Stocktwits participant independently describes an open 30,000-share short position being covered into the 09-01 spike, consistent with the distribution read - docs/c5bbd876dfcb8d50e0aaf346d4f71f1c079e35f8.txt

baseline_tension: It agrees with the run-up (-27% over 20 days, -5% over 5) and with the 3-of-4 negative reaction history, but it argues for a much larger magnitude than the 3.9% median, because the baseline median predates the current 146% realised vol regime.
